provenance.rationale: The Day 6 English Word text identifies the Argentine side of Iguazu and onward travel to Buenos Aires, joined as one route heading.

blocks.text:
In the morning, your guide meets you at the hotel for an excursion to the Argentine side of Iguazu Falls. Cross the Tancredo Neves Bridge and explore the national park on walkways and viewing platforms above and below the cascades. See the Devil’s Throat, the most powerful of the falls, and rainbows hanging over the rushing water.

After the tour, transfer to the airport for the included flight to Buenos Aires. On arrival, a driver meets you and takes you to the hotel. Three nights in Buenos Aires are planned.

provenance.rationale: The English narrative follows the approved Word Day 6 text without its day-number marker; the final overnight detail comes from the Word programme overview.
